text:
## Purpose  
Establish procedures for identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions) to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance.

raw_entities.name: Operational Exception Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions including failed transactions, disputed transactions, and regulatory exceptions. Designed to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance throughout the resolution workflow.
context: Establish procedures for identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions)
ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance

raw_entities.name: Exception Identification
raw_entities.description: Initial step to identify and flag operational exceptions including failed transactions, disputed transactions, and regulatory exceptions within the banking system.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions)

raw_entities.name: Exception Investigation
raw_entities.description: Detailed examination and analysis of identified operational exceptions to determine root cause, impact, and appropriate resolution pathway.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions

raw_entities.name: Exception Resolution
raw_entities.description: Final step to implement corrective actions and resolve operational exceptions, ensuring customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance requirements are met.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance

raw_entities.name: Failed Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that did not complete successfully and requires investigation and resolution as part of the operational exception process.
context: failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions

raw_entities.name: Disputed Transaction
raw_entities.description: A financial transaction that a customer has contested or disputed, requiring investigation and resolution to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance.
context: failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Exception Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint to verify that regulatory exceptions are properly identified, investigated, and resolved in accordance with regulatory requirements.
context: ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance
